# heading-start-left

- ID: `MD023`
- Category: Headings
- Default: on, severity warning
- Fixable: yes
- Tags: `headings`, `spaces`

Headings start at the beginning of their line, list item or blockquote.

## Why

Some parsers do not recognize an indented heading and show it as plain text.

## Options

This rule has no options.

## Fix

The fix deletes the extra indentation. gomdlint may report a finding without a
fix when the fix would change a line with one character in brackets, such as
\[x\] or \[1\], or the lines around it up to a blank line, because it could add
or remove a task list checkbox.

## Example

This document breaks the rule:

```markdown
# Guide

  ## Install

Run the installer.
```

gomdlint reports:

```text
3:1 Heading is indented by 2 character(s)
```

The fix changes it to:

```markdown
# Guide

## Install

Run the installer.
```

## Configure

Under `rules`, `heading-start-left: false` turns the rule off and
`heading-start-left: error` reports its findings as errors. The flag
`--disable heading-start-left` turns it off for one run.

## Silence one line

```markdown
<!-- markdownlint-disable-next-line heading-start-left -->
```
